title: Bluest Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document covers Bluest account opening and ongoing requirements: deposit at least $75,000 to open, and maintain a daily balance of $112,500 to keep benefits active. It lists a $75/month maintenance fee if below that balance, a $0.00 returned deposit fee, and a $15,000 daily debit card purchase limit.
faqs: What is the minimum deposit required to open a Bluest account?
What daily balance do I need to keep all Bluest account benefits active?
What is the monthly maintenance fee if my daily balance falls below $112,500?
Is there a fee for returned deposits/unpaid checks, and what is it?
What is my daily debit card purchase limit on the Bluest account?
How can I avoid the monthly maintenance fee and stay within the debit card limit?
keywords: Maintain daily balance to keep benefits active
